name: Turn a finding into an eval case, list the agent's set, run it twice and compare
description: From PR #482's Agent runs tab, expand the top-severity ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit') finding — already accepted by the seed — and turn it into an eval case, asserting only the invariant head of the interpolated confirmation. Navigate to the eval dashboard via /evals and open the Security Reviewer's own dashboard page at /evals/:agentId (the card links straight to it; that route used to be a redirect into the agent editor and is now the real page). Assert the header counts the new case (9 = 8 seeded + 1) and that the metric cards stay in the never-run state rather than rendering a fabricated 0%. No provider credential is configured in this environment, so ConfigError is thrown synchronously before any network call is made — start the suite run and assert it still completes and persists with every one of the 9 cases failing down that path ('0/9'), which is this flow's proof of zero model calls on the real run path. Start a second suite run so two completed, comparable runs exist, select both run checkboxes, click the Compare control that becomes enabled at exactly two selected — changing the selection closes the modal, so the control is the only thing that opens it — and assert the compare view's older/newer/difference layout, the all-caps RECALL metric row, the System prompt section, and the same-agent-version statement (both runs ran the unmodified agent, so nothing changed between them). Finally follow the dashboard's 'Configure eval cases →' link into /agents/:id?tab=evals, which still owns eval-case CRUD, and confirm the new case is listed there. Exercises POST /findings/:id/eval-case, GET /agents/:id/eval-cases, POST /agents/:id/eval-runs/start and GET /agents/:id/eval-runs/compare. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo and the Security Reviewer agent owns exactly 8 seeded eval cases and no suite runs yet (see e2e/README.md).
